policy: Records remote/small-island ports whose local public onward access has been reviewed. Use no_scheduled_public_bus only when the island has no ordinary scheduled public bus route suitable for gameplay; tourist-only, hotel shuttle, rental vehicle, bicycle, taxi-only, and demand/on-call services are not promoted as playable scheduled bus.
